tokens.name: lapis
tokens.usage: Issuer Lapis: the band, the origin plate, primary buttons, text selection, and the logo tile. Means "Heimdall speaks or acts".

tokens.name: lapis-strong
tokens.usage: Deep Lapis: hover of lapis fills. Lighter than base in the dark theme so the change stays visible.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Equals lapis by day; a pale lapis at night that keeps AA on page, ground and red tint.

tokens.name: on-lapis
tokens.usage: Text on the band and plate; the eye in the logo.

tokens.name: on-lapis-muted
tokens.usage: Mist: the plate label and the hover underline of band navigation.

tokens.name: client
tokens.usage: Client Slate: band and plate of a client app such as the demo SPA. Says "this is not Heimdall".

tokens.name: client-strong
tokens.usage: Hover of client slate.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text, headings, control borders, the table header rule.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, footnotes, fact labels, footer text. Passes 4.5:1 on page and ground.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The sheet behind the column; fill of inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Footer, note box, secondary-button hover, body background.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px hairlines in lists, tables and the footer edge.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Signal Yellow: keyboard focus only. Never in the logo or anywhere else.

tokens.name: focus-ink
tokens.usage: The ink underline of the focus field.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Refusal Red: errors, refusals, invalid fields.

tokens.name: red-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the problem box.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Confirmation Green: a done or confirmed result.

tokens.name: green-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the confirm box.

families.sans: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Liberation Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The one page title, such as "Sign in". Source size is clamp(2rem, 1.6rem + 1.6vw, 2.75rem); 2.75rem is its largest step.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The name "Heimdall" in the band, beside the eye mark. The only 800 weight.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text, tabular numerals on, 34em measure.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, message box titles, table captions.

styles.name: hint
styles.usage: Field hints, field errors (700, red), table text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Footnotes, fact labels, the plate label, the footer.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Machine values a person compares: hosts, client IDs, scopes, error codes. Inherits its size in use; 1.125rem shown here, as on the plate host.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: 4px rhythm base.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Field stack: label, error, input.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Tight stack: heading to its list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gutters; list item padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page stack between blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: A table below its lead text.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Content below the plate; new demo section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Space at the end of the sheet.

tokens.name: space-band-height
tokens.usage: The issuer band.

tokens.name: space-control
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-border
tokens.usage: Control border width.

tokens.name: space-column
tokens.usage: The page column's maximum width.

tokens.name: space-column-wide
tokens.usage: The demo client's wide column, for tables.

tokens.name: space-frame
tokens.usage: The centred frame track.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every corner, the logo tile included. The plate notch is the only shaped edge.

tokens.name: shadow-focus-field
tokens.usage: Every focus-visible control, with a 3px yellow outline. The only shadow in the system.

tokens.name: shadow-link-focus
tokens.usage: Every focus-visible link, on a yellow background.
